notes.title: Balance update and hotfixes
notes.notes:
Change mobs
At the request of the players, the enemies were rebalanced, now some of them have become slower, while the other part has been redesigned characteristics
Sound changes
The volume of many objects, mainly mobs, has been changed, now many of them have become quieter
Fixed enemy movement zones
Fixed the moment when mobs do not allow to leave the spawn point

notes.title: Simantik release
notes.notes:
After 9 months of work, we release the game!
We hope you enjoy it, you can try it today!
